policy.exclusion_E1: >=2 member languages carry an external (non-Uralic) loan flag
policy.exclusion_E2: fully-loan set (all attested members loan-flagged, >=1 external) spanning >=2 languages
policy.kept_set_cell_recode: loan-flagged cells in kept sets recoded to '?'
policy.singletons: single-language external loans KEPT (autapomorphies, no false grouping)
policy.ambiguous_sources: cross-boundary disjunctions (e.g. Germanic_or_Finnic) treated as external
